## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Nov 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Seibzehn_, Sep 13, 2026, 2/5: "Finch initially makes a friendly and well thought-out impression. The concept can be particularly helpful for people who have difficulties with motivation, routines, procrastination or their general well-being. What I find all the more disappointing is the way they try to sell a subscription during onboarding. After you have just told the app in which personal areas you need support, an emotionally designed offer appears with statements such as “Biggest discount ever”, “One-time offer” and finally even “Offer expires when you exit this screen!”. I was offered a 50% discount and €39.99 per year instead of €79.99. The actual price and the automatic extension are stated transparently - that is not my criticism. What I find problematic is the artificial time pressure and the fear of losing a supposedly unique offer. With a regular app, aggressive paywall marketing would bother me. I find it particularly inappropriate for a self-care app. Ultimately, the target group can include people who are looking for support with ADHD, anxiety, depression, impulse control, motivation or self-organization. In my opinion, this is where you should handle FOMO and psychological selling pressure particularly responsibly. I would expressly not like to describe the app itself as dubious. I actually like the concept. However, for me, the type of marketing does not match the trusting and supportive claim of a self-care app. It would also be desirable to have a complete German translation of the app and a lifetime purchase option for users who deliberately do not want to take out another permanent subscription. I think a fair one-off payment would be very appropriate, especially for an app that is intended to help you build routines over the long term."
            2. _Anonymouse123abc_, Nov 10, 2026, 4/5: "Needs more opportunities to get rainbow stones, had it for 5 days only got 600, things are too expensive, but good app"
            3. _mysticalgamer666_, Aug 6, 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Nov 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _Tomsbit_, Nov 11, 2026, 5/5: "I've been using this app for years and it is amazing! But a recent update has changed the little mood logger's animation to be much slower, which isn't an issue because I can just disable animations. But when doing that I noticed that only some animations are disabled? Like, the Finch and longer animations are disabled but all the transition animations are still there. I'm not sure if this is a bug or not, but it's very weird. If it's meant to be an accessibility feature (which it may not be, I suppose) then there still being animations present could cause issues, no?"
            3. _J@NE R0B1NETT_, Nov 11, 2026, 5/5: "It’s a chill self care app with a few bugs but still cool"
<!--/ir-theme-->
